title: IMAGEBIND: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
problem: Learning a true joint embedding across many modalities requires acquiring all types and combinations of paired data with the same set of images, which is infeasible.
Final embeddings from prior multimodal methods are limited to the modality pairs used for training, so embeddings like video-audio cannot directly support image-text tasks and vice versa.
There is an absence of large quantities of multimodal data where all modalities are present together.
core_techniques: [3.2] IMAGEBIND uses pairs of modalities (I,M), where I represents images and M is another modality, to learn a single joint embedding. | 이미지를 기준 축으로 삼아 각 다른 모달리티를 이미지와 정렬해 단일 공동 임베딩을 학습한다.

[3.2] Given an image Ii and its corresponding obser-
vation in the other modality Mi, we encode them into nor-
malized embeddings: qi = f(Ii) and ki = g(Mi) where
f,g are deep networks. | 이미지와 타 모달리티를 각각 심층 네트워크로 정규화 임베딩으로 인코딩한다.
[3.2] The embeddings and the encoders are optimized using an InfoNCE [54] loss | 임베딩과 인코더를 InfoNCE 대조학습 손실로 최적화한다.
[3.2] In practice, we use a symmetric loss LI,M + LM,I. | 양방향 정렬을 위해 대칭 손실을 사용한다.
[3.2] we only train using the pairs (I,M1) and (I,M2) | 서로 직접 짝지어지지 않은 모달리티들 사이에도 이미지 매개 정렬로 emergent alignment가 나타나도록 학습한다.

[3.3] We use a Transformer architec-
ture [73] for all the modality encoders. | 모든 모달리티 인코더에 Transformer 아키텍처를 사용한다.
[3.3] We use the Vision Transformer (ViT) [13] for images. | 이미지 인코더로 ViT를 사용한다.
[3.3] We follow [22] for encoding audio and convert a 2 second audio sampled at 16kHz into spectrograms using 128 mel-spectrogram bins. | 오디오는 16kHz 2초 구간을 128-bin mel-spectrogram으로 변환해 인코딩한다.

[3.3] We treat ther-
mal images and depth images as one-channel images | 열영상과 깊이 영상을 1채널 이미지로 처리한다.
[3.3] We extract the IMU signal consisting of accelerometer and gyroscope measurements across the X, Y, and Z axes. | IMU는 3축 가속도계·자이로스코프 신호를 사용한다.

[3.3] We add a modality-
specific linear projection head on each encoder to obtain a
fixed size d dimensional embedding | 각 모달리티 인코더 뒤에 선형 projection head를 붙여 고정 차원 임베딩을 만든다.

[3.3] this setup allows us to also initialize a subset of the encoders using pretrained models, e.g., the image and text encoder using CLIP [60] or OpenCLIP [30]. | 이미지·텍스트 인코더를 CLIP/OpenCLIP 사전학습 모델로 초기화한다.
limitations: [6] Our image alignment loss can be enriched by using other alignment data, for instance other modalities paired with text, or with each other (e.g. audio with IMU).
[6] Our embeddings are trained without a specific downstream task, and thus lag the performance of specialist models.
[6] Our model is a research prototype and cannot be readily used for real world applications ( Appendix F).
[F] joint embedding may also create unintentional associations.
[F] IMAGEBIND leverages the image-text embeddings learned by a pretrained model on large web-based data which has biases as documented in different studies [60].
[F] These joint embeddings are thus limited to the concepts present in the datasets.
